projects.name: M5AirQ-Rust
properties: Requests without a valid session, bearer token or API key are never granted; expired sessions and empty secrets never grant
State-changing routes require admin rights; token-over-HTTP is refused when disabled
OTA writes target the inactive slot, stay in bounds and are sequential
A failed flash write poisons the session; an update completes only if read-back, magic, CRC and activation all succeed

projects.name: SpoolEase
properties: Unauthenticated requests are refused
Every committed inventory row can be read back after a reboot
New spool ids are fresh; edits that change nothing write nothing; deleting an absent spool is a no-op
Rows stay within the store's size limits when they grow or are relocated

projects.name: td-free
properties: Spoolman requests are forwarded only to a usable server; calibration needs a client; device info needs a ready sensor
Read-only requests change no stored state; Wi-Fi updates reset the connection
Boot never locks the user out of Wi-Fi setup
Sensor register updates change only the intended bits

projects.name: pico-bit
properties: File names cannot traverse paths and decode to confined, ASCII names
Percent-decoding and request classification are total (never fail)
Mutations need POST or DELETE; deletes never touch the payload
Uploads are bounded; the network route exposes only the staged binary

projects.name: anova-oven-rs
properties: Retry backoff is bounded and monotone; a successful poll recovers
User requests pre-empt polling; queue operations keep other entries
Reset classification never masks a panic; cold boot dominates
The invariant holds in every reachable state

projects.name: esp-hal-wifimanager
projects.interface: HTTP captive portal: Wi-Fi provisioning + OTA
properties: Only credentials that connected are stored; invalid or superseded setups are never stored
Oversized setups are ignored; setups after connecting are refused
OTA needs its parameters; reset only after a verified image
Read-only requests change nothing

projects.name: heater-control
properties: Duty sent to the heater is at most 100%; out-of-range duty is refused
Anonymous, mismatched or expired remotes are refused and send nothing
Over-temperature locks the heater until it cools; a missing reading locks it
SSR pulse patterns stay within 0–100%

projects.name: rc-car
properties: Motor and steering percentages stay in range for every command
Servo duty stays within the pulse range; the arithmetic cannot overflow
Brake light only on deceleration and off after its timeout
Blinker commands take effect; blinker off turns the lamps off

projects.name: crown-of-the-lamb
properties: Only valid AP names are stored; settings are clamped into range
A pending save completes before a restart
OTA is POST-only, one at a time, bounded, checks the first sector's magic
The device restarts only into a committed image

projects.name: AM03127-Controller
properties: Page and schedule ids are valid; encoded messages contain no raw protocol brackets
Message encoding is total; dates and times are two digits
OTA proceeds only with a length and completes exactly when all bytes arrived

projects.name: autodoggo
properties: Overcurrent reverses a closing door and stops an opening one; the timeout stops the motor
A stale overcurrent flag is ignored; no motion is commanded without the driver
A stop is kept while the pulley ramps down
Only one H-bridge channel is driven at a time; duty never exceeds the maximum

projects.name: blind_controller.rs
properties: A move never exceeds the full travel; lowering stops at the bottom
The position estimate follows the moves; idle at the limits
Microstep counts saturate instead of overflowing

projects.name: garaza-pico-rs
properties: A request starts one pulse of the configured length, which always ends low
Requests during a pulse are coalesced; the next pulse waits for the pause
The relay is high only while a pulse is running

projects.name: omni-wheel-bot
properties: The watchdog stops the motors when commands are overdue and is quiet when disarmed
An active command arms it; a held lease is not taken
The closed control surface needs the secret

projects.name: energy-monitor-ha
properties: The stored password is never served
Sample-count and period computations never divide by zero
MQTT publishing needs its ids

projects.name: aquarium-lid-pcb
properties: Only consistent alarm and fan configurations are admitted
The alarm fires above the high and below the low threshold, is reachable, and clears with hysteresis
The fan turns on above, off below, and holds in between

projects.name: thermal-printer
properties: Text is only cut at UTF-8 character boundaries and every cut makes progress
Printable output excludes control bytes

projects.name: esp-sign
properties: Colour parsing is total and accepts exactly the #rrggbb shape

projects.name: esp32-http-stepper
properties: Commands for a motor that does not exist are refused
Zero speed and zero acceleration are refused
Exactly the valid commands are queued

projects.name: chlorophyll
properties: Commands for another device are ignored
An over-long name keeps the old one; an unchanged name is not written
Flash writes are spaced; only valid configurations are stored; over-long datagrams are dropped

projects.name: cloggo
properties: The linear regression never panics for any calibration data; zero divisors are refused
Pressure conversion never panics
Fixed-point arithmetic is modelled bit-exactly (I32F32)

projects.name: diy-weather-station
properties: An update starts only with a token and a length that fits
Chunks are contiguous and within the declared length
An update completes iff every byte was written; an aborted update never completes
The new image is confirmed only after the web server is up

projects.name: pico_dhcp_dns_server
properties: Discovery keeps live leases; a request is acknowledged only for its own lease
DNS answers stay within the packet bounds
